alternativeExplanations.title: As a square garden
steps: A square garden has area 25 square meters. Each side is the number that multiplies by itself to give 25.
Side length: 5 meters — lengths are positive, so the garden answer is the positive root.

alternativeExplanations.title: Undo the square
steps: Squaring and square-rooting undo each other, like tying and untying a shoe.
√25 = 5, and its mirror twin −5 also works since a negative times a negative is positive.
